title: Yantra book
description: Several answer pages (chapters) read in order, built into one offline HTML file with scroll, book (one screen at a time) and present modes. Each chapter follows the answer page rules: its answer first, then blocks.

title.description: The book's title, on its cover.

description.description: One sentence under the title: what the reader will understand by the end.

kicker.description: A short label beside the logo (Handbook, Onboarding, ...).

reading.description: How the book opens: book (one screen at a time, like an e-reader), scroll (one long page) or present (one row of blocks per slide). Readers can switch; their place is kept in their browser, and #read= / #at= in the URL override both.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag; chapters without their own meta.lang inherit it (and dir and strings).

watermark.description: false hides the "Made with Yantra" badge; a string replaces its text.

summary.description: The whole book in two or three sentences (light markdown), on the cover above the contents.

chapters.description: 1-12 chapters, in reading order: answer pages inline (kind "page" or no kind), or { "$ref": "chapter.json" } relative to the book's file and inside its folder.

$ref.description: A chapter in its own .json file (an answer page), relative to the book.
